controller_6m.notes: Quote verified verbatim on p274 under 'By our Controlling Shareholders' (Rule 10.07). CONVENTION CORRECTION: 'ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date' ends the first period ON the anniversary 2027-01-09, which is therefore the last restricted day; first free day is 2027-01-10.

corrections.basis: Rule 10.07(1)(a): no disposal in the period ending ON the date which is six months from the Listing Date (2027-01-09, inclusive); first free day 2027-01-10

controller_12m.notes: Quote verified verbatim on p274 (further six months leg). DATE CORRECTION: the further six months commence at expiry of the first period (ends ON 2027-01-09) and run to and including the 12-month anniversary 2027-07-09; first free day is 2027-07-10. No longer (24-month) shareholder lock-up exists in this prospectus (p277 'twelve months' hit is only the Note 3 pledge-notice undertaking).
